methodology: Historical walk-forward backtest. Predictions reconstructed from pre-kickoff information only; actual results attached after modelling.

scope.note: Verified UEFA Nations League fixtures from the configured league universe; sample intentionally excludes fixtures lacking sufficiently reconstructable pre-match inputs.

safeguards: No post-match statistics may be used as model inputs.
Actual score is attached only after prediction is frozen.
Completed matches remain out of the public daily prediction feed.
